description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerAPI class which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers. It uses annotations for API documentation and extends base endpoint classes. The class encapsulates logic for validation, role-based access, and interaction with the Customer data via service and DAO layers.

classes.name: CustomerAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations for Customer entities in the time tracking module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all customers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove customers by IDs, with error handling if customers have logged time.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update customer details by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing customers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a customer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting customers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single customer.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a customer.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method returning validation rules for customer creation/update payload.

methods.name: getNameCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns configuration for unique name validation, ignoring current entity for update operations.

methods.name: setParamsToCustomer
methods.description: Populates Customer entity properties from request parameters.
